spec.title: Component Uptime
spec.description: Whether each Airflow component's metrics endpoint (scheduler, dag processor, webserver) is up. 0 means the component is down or unreachable.

spec.title: Process CPU Usage
spec.description: CPU time consumed by each Airflow component process, as a fraction of a core.

spec.title: Process Memory Usage
spec.description: Resident memory of each Airflow component process. Useful to size resources.requests/limits and spot leaks.

spec.title: DAG Import Errors
spec.description: Number of DAG files the DAG processor currently fails to import (syntax errors, missing dependencies, etc.). Should be 0.

spec.title: DAG Bag Size
spec.description: Number of DAGs currently loaded by the DAG processor.

spec.title: DAG Parsing Time
spec.description: Total time to parse all DAG files in the DAGs folder in the last parsing loop. Rising values indicate the DAG processor is falling behind.

spec.title: DAG Processing Queue & Workers
spec.description: Number of DAG files still waiting to be parsed, and number of parsing worker processes in use.

spec.title: Scheduler Loop Duration
spec.description: Time taken for one scheduler loop iteration (find and queue schedulable tasks). Sustained increases point to scheduler DB contention or an overloaded scheduler.

spec.title: Scheduler Critical Section Duration
spec.description: Time spent inside the scheduler's critical section (holding the DB lock while assigning tasks to the executor).

spec.title: Scheduler Anomalies
spec.description: Tasks the scheduler had to recover after a scheduler/executor restart (adopted/cleared), and tasks killed outside of Airflow (e.g. evicted or OOM-killed pods). Sustained non-zero rates indicate scheduler instability or resource pressure.

spec.title: DAG Run Completion Rate
spec.description: Rate of DAG runs completing successfully vs. failing.

spec.title: DAG Run Duration (Success)
spec.description: End-to-end duration of successful DAG runs.

spec.title: DAG Run Duration (Failed)
spec.description: End-to-end duration of failed DAG runs.

spec.title: DAG Run Schedule Delay
spec.description: Delay between a DAG run's scheduled logical date and when it was actually created. High values indicate the scheduler cannot keep up.

spec.title: First Task Scheduling Delay
spec.description: Delay between a DAG run starting and its first task instance being scheduled.

spec.title: Task Instance Throughput
spec.description: Rate of new task instances being created vs. task/operator failures.

spec.title: Task Scheduled Duration
spec.description: Time between a task instance being scheduled and actually starting to run. High values indicate executor/Kubernetes scheduling bottlenecks (e.g. insufficient cluster capacity).

spec.title: DAG Run Success Rate
spec.description: Rate of successful DAG runs, broken down per DAG (extracted from Airflow's per-DAG StatsD metric names via a Prometheus __name__ regex + label_replace, so DAGs are picked up/dropped automatically as they're added/removed). Task-level metrics (e.g. airflow_ti_running_<pool>_<dag>_<task>, airflow_dag_<dag>_<task>_scheduled_duration) are intentionally excluded from this per-DAG breakdown: pool/dag/task names are joined with plain underscores with no reliable delimiter, so a regex cannot safely tell where the DAG name ends and the task name begins for arbitrary tenant DAG/task names.

spec.title: DAG Run Failure Rate
spec.description: Rate of failed DAG runs, broken down per DAG. Any DAG with a non-zero rate is highlighted so failing DAGs are visible at a glance. Task-level metrics (e.g. airflow_ti_running_<pool>_<dag>_<task>, airflow_dag_<dag>_<task>_scheduled_duration) are intentionally excluded from this per-DAG breakdown: pool/dag/task names are joined with plain underscores with no reliable delimiter, so a regex cannot safely tell where the DAG name ends and the task name begins for arbitrary tenant DAG/task names.

spec.title: Avg DAG Run Duration (Success)
spec.description: Average duration of successful DAG runs per DAG (rate(sum)/rate(count) of Airflow's per-DAG dagrun_duration_success Summary). Task-level metrics (e.g. airflow_ti_running_<pool>_<dag>_<task>, airflow_dag_<dag>_<task>_scheduled_duration) are intentionally excluded from this per-DAG breakdown: pool/dag/task names are joined with plain underscores with no reliable delimiter, so a regex cannot safely tell where the DAG name ends and the task name begins for arbitrary tenant DAG/task names.

spec.title: Avg DAG Run Duration (Failed)
spec.description: Average duration of failed DAG runs per DAG (rate(sum)/rate(count) of Airflow's per-DAG dagrun_duration_failed Summary). Task-level metrics (e.g. airflow_ti_running_<pool>_<dag>_<task>, airflow_dag_<dag>_<task>_scheduled_duration) are intentionally excluded from this per-DAG breakdown: pool/dag/task names are joined with plain underscores with no reliable delimiter, so a regex cannot safely tell where the DAG name ends and the task name begins for arbitrary tenant DAG/task names.

spec.title: DAG Run Schedule Delay (avg)
spec.description: Average delay between a DAG run's scheduled logical date and when it was actually created, per DAG. High values mean the scheduler cannot keep up with that DAG's schedule. Task-level metrics (e.g. airflow_ti_running_<pool>_<dag>_<task>, airflow_dag_<dag>_<task>_scheduled_duration) are intentionally excluded from this per-DAG breakdown: pool/dag/task names are joined with plain underscores with no reliable delimiter, so a regex cannot safely tell where the DAG name ends and the task name begins for arbitrary tenant DAG/task names.

spec.title: Time Since Last DAG Parse
spec.description: Time since each DAG's file was last parsed by the DAG processor. A steadily growing value for one DAG while others stay low means that DAG's file is stuck (e.g. an import error or the processor falling behind). Task-level metrics (e.g. airflow_ti_running_<pool>_<dag>_<task>, airflow_dag_<dag>_<task>_scheduled_duration) are intentionally excluded from this per-DAG breakdown: pool/dag/task names are joined with plain underscores with no reliable delimiter, so a regex cannot safely tell where the DAG name ends and the task name begins for arbitrary tenant DAG/task names.
